INSTRUCTIONS TO MEMBERS OF THE
CRIME BRANCH AT HEADQUARTERS.

Foreign and Chinese officers will be immediately
available on Sundays, holidays, evenings and at all times
when the offices are not open in a normal way, as follows:-

C. 1. The Superintendent or Chief Inspector will
leave their telephone numbers with the Telephone
Clerk when not actually in their homes, either
one or the other will be available for emergency
calls. One Foreign Sub-Inspector, one Chinese
Sub-Inspector, one Chinese Sergeant and one Chinese
Constable will be on duty on or within call of
the office on Saturday afternoons, Sundays, Holidays
and after office hours.

C. 2. One Foreign and one Chinese will be on duty
as above.

C. 3. No licenses should be issued outside of office
hours except under special instructions but the
officer in charge should be available by telephone
if required urgently.

C. 4. The officer in charge should be within telephone
call at all times in case of emergency.

C. 5. One Foreign and one Chinese should be available
by telephone at all times after office hours.

C. 6. The officer on duty in C. 2. should be in
possession of the Studio keys and be able to get in
touch with the photographer.

The Telephone Clerk will keep a special book for
all Headquarters officers and should be communicated with
either to leave telephone numbers or to ascertain the

刑事与特别处登记室 (22)
（刑事与特别处）办公备忘录
日期：1931年2月25日。
刑事与特别处总部。
编号：S. D. D. 8/22
日期：31年2月27日

致总部刑事处成员的指令。

外籍和华人警官在星期日、节假日、晚间以及办公室非正常开放的所有时间内，须立即听候调遣，具体安排如下：-

C. 1. 警司或总督察若不在家中，须将电话号码留给电话接线员，二者中必有一人可接听紧急呼叫。一名外籍副督察、一名华人副督察、一名华人巡长和一名华人巡警须在星期六下午、星期日、节假日以及办公时间结束后，在办公室值班或随叫随到。

C. 2. 一名外籍人员和一名华人人员按上述规定值班。

C. 3. 除非有特别指示，否则不得在办公时间以外签发任何执照，但如有紧急需要，负责警官应能通过电话联系到。

C. 4. 负责警官须在任何时候保持电话畅通，以备紧急情况之需。

C. 5. 一名外籍人员和一名华人人员在办公时间结束后须随时保持电话畅通。

C. 6. C. 2. 项下的值班警官应持有照相室钥匙，并能够联系上摄影师。

电话接线员须为所有总部警官设立专用登记簿，以便联络他们留下电话号码或查明

The names, addresses and telephone numbers of
all members of the various Sections Chinese and Foreign
should be posted in the offices of each Section and all
telephone numbers should be known to the Central Telephone
Clerk.
Officers in charge Sections C.1., C.2., and C.5.
will submit a duty roster weekly, one copy to be sent to
the Central Telephone Clerk, one copy to be posted in the
office of the Section concerned and one copy for
P. A. (C. & S.B.).
Deputy Commissioner
for (Crime & Special Branches)
